validation_issues.message: Variable font has no 'HVAR' table — advance widths won't vary; renderers must fall back to per-glyph hmtx lookups
TrueType font has no 'gasp' table — grid-fitting behavior per ppem is implementation-defined
Full name 'Mona Sans VF' doesn't match Family + Subfamily 'Mona Sans VF Regular'
OS/2.panose is all zeros — PANOSE classification helps font matching in some applications
